layout add/remove; referenced deletion preserves unresolved selector and alerts
condition rule edits and disabled state use production controls
actual Rust common and condition provenance / explicit false/null/empty values
actual edit changes backend numeric AND outcome, while original raw ID remains unchanged
actual position editing before/after controls changes backend atom outcomes
edit invalidates a pending real Rust reply, cancelled reply remains dismissed
error retry preserves input and exact IPC input, blank raw ID avoids calls
no external traffic; only isolated Rust transport POST; clean console and fit
